Model-Specific Construction

Superior Standard Features

A thoughtfully engineered exterior shell begins with sturdy materials and attentive jobsite craftsmanship.

Solid Foundation4×6 pressure-treated foundation beams and 16×16×4-inch solid concrete pads, with engineered support layout for the building.
Durable Floor System2×6 pressure-treated floor joists at 16 inches on center and ¾-inch pressure-treated exterior-rated plywood floor decking.
Strong Wall Framing2×4 kiln-dried wall studs at 16 inches on center, built and assembled on your property.
Distinctive Gambrel RoofTraditional barn roof profile with upper 7/12 and lower 20/12 pitches; roof framing engineered to the building and local requirements.
Weather-Resistant Exterior½-inch CDX roof sheathing, architectural asphalt shingles, synthetic underlayment and carefully installed siding and trim.
Craftsman CharacterSite-built double wood barn doors, durable hardware, cedar trim, and an integrated open-sided firewood storage area.

Final component design, flashing, ventilation, anchorage and details are documented for the selected model and site.

Frequently Asked Questions

Good to Know

Is my Appalachian Barn built on site?

Yes. Every Appalachian Barn is constructed on your property by our crew.

What is included in the listed price?

The listed price is for the standard exterior weather-tight shell with the selected siding, including an unfinished interior. Interior wall and ceiling finishes, insulation, utilities and climate control are not included.

Do I need to paint or caulk the exterior?

Required exterior caulking and painting or staining must be completed within 30 days of construction. Optional professional exterior finishing is available from Appalachian Sheds.

Can I request a larger size or different configuration?

Yes. Ask us to discuss larger sizes, custom features and your intended use during the proposal process.

How are site conditions handled?

Standard foundation leveling includes up to 6 inches of out-of-level conditions. Extra leveling or site preparation is quoted in writing as needed.
